title: II. Proper or figurative attributes; three genera of proper attributes
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): II. Ye attributes belonging toward God are proper or figurative. Ye proper attributes belonging toward God of three genera are. Some as of being are; others as of living virtually; others as of living integrally. Those unto God simply belong, with respect unto essence, insofar as in ye highest manner He is; these evidently, with respect unto intelligent life, insofar as He understands, wills, acts, plus works; these excellently, with respect unto virtue plus beatitude, insofar as well plus blessedly He acts. This jointly plus separately is proved. Jointly, by ye words TRUE plus LIVING (Jeremiah 10:10; 1 Thessalonians 1:9; Revelation 1:17-18). Separately, with respect unto essence (Exodus 3:14; Isaiah 44:6; Revelation 1:8 plus 21:6 plus 22:13); with respect unto spiritual life (Deuteronomy 32:40; Judges 8:19; 1 Samuel 25:34; Psalm 18:47; 84:3; John 4:24; 1 Timothy 1:17; Colossians 1:15); with respect unto integrity (Deuteronomy 32:4; Matthew 5:48).
pass_b_english: II. The attributes of God are proper or figurative. The proper attributes of God are of three genera. Some are as of being; others as of living virtually; others as of living integrally.

Those belong to God simply, with respect to essence, insofar as He is in the highest manner; these evidently, with respect to intelligent life, insofar as He understands, wills, acts, and works; these excellently, with respect to virtue and beatitude, insofar as He acts well and blessedly. This is proved jointly and separately. Jointly, by the words TRUE and LIVING (Jeremiah 10:10; 1 Thessalonians 1:9; Revelation 1:17-18). Separately, with respect to essence (Exodus 3:14; Isaiah 44:6; Revelation 1:8 and 21:6 and 22:13); with respect to spiritual life (Deuteronomy 32:40; Judges 8:19; 1 Samuel 25:34; Psalm 18:47; 84:3; John 4:24; 1 Timothy 1:17; Colossians 1:15); with respect to integrity (Deuteronomy 32:4; Matthew 5:48).
source_text: II. Attributa Dei sunt propria aut figurata. Attributa Dei propria trium sunt generum. Alia sunt, ut entis, alia, ut viventis virtualiter, alia, ut viventis integre. Illa conveniunt Deo simpliciter, respectu essentiae, quatenus est summo modo: ista evidenter, respectu vitae intelligentis, quatenus intelligit, vult, agit & operatur: haec excellenter, respectu virtutis ac beatitudinis, quatenus bene beateque agit. Hoc probatur conjunctim ac discretim. Conjunctim, verbis VERI & VIVI, Jer. 10.10; 1 Thess. 1.9; Apoc. 1.17.18. Discretim, respectu essentiae, Exod. 3.14; Esai. 44.6; Apoc. 1.8 & 21.6 & 22.13; respectu vitae spiritualis, Deut. 32.40; Jud. 8.19; 1 Sam. 25.34; Psal. 18.47; 84.3; Joh. 4.24; 1 Tim. 1.17; Col. 1.15; respectu integritatis, Deut. 32.4; Matth. 5.48.
